♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 E TŠWILE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions ka **Your script** le **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe**, le **Flex Studio (Beta)** yeo e thomago ka go laolla gomme e go botšiša pele e tsenywa.

*(Tsenya godimo ga phetolelo ya gago ya bjale gomme o thome After Effects gape gatee.)*

♦️ **Mpsha: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* Peakanyo ya **Map desk**, go nyaka mafelo ntle le inthanete, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route le tše dingwe), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, ditaele tša mmapa tša mahala le **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Didirišwa tša yona tša tlaleletšo (go sinkronaesa ka nako yeo, ditaele, maleibole, 3D, Finalize) bjale di bulega ka nnete ka gare ga After Effects.

♦️ **Tše mpsha go AutoCaptions**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (leru, e diriša dikhrediti tša Flex AI) ke enjene ye e šišinywago, e kgethilwe gatee go bohle. Kgetha Whisper gape go dira dikepšene mahala khomphutheng ya gago (Translate To e nyaka Whisper). Ge seva se swaregile, o tla bona sebaka sa gago molaleng.
* **Your script**: dikepšene di tšea mopeleto le mantšu a sengwalwa sa gago gohle mo o boletšego mantšu ao.
* Tšweletšo ya **Editable template**: dikepšene bjalo ka malera a thempoleite ao o ka a fetošago setaele go Essential Properties (After Effects 2026).
* Ga go selo se se kgethilwego gomme Source media e se na selo? E go fa **khomposišene ka moka**. Modumo o swanago o šomiša gape thranskripte ya wona.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e a laolla, ke moka e botšiša **Install / Not now**.
* Tirišo (2.0.0-beta.2): mafelo a go šoma a **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING**, dinotlelo tša didirišwa go swana le tša After Effects, dikliphi di bulega gatee, gomme OPEN e šoma le go di-precomp le malera a phetolo.

♦️ **Go lokišitšwe**
* Dieffekte tša theme tšeo di bego di le sieo go di-PC tše dintši tša Windows di boile (di bofefo ge dieffekte tša animation tša Windows di timilwe).

♦️ **Lefelo la boikgethelo go šireletša laesense**
* E botšišwa gatee feela, ke boikgethelo: ka **No thanks** tšohle di tšwela pele di šoma. E fetoše go **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E bolokwa dikgwedi tše 12, ga e rekišwe le ka mohla, ebile ga e abelanwe le ka mohla ntle le ge molao o nyaka seo.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 E TŠWILE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack e hudugela go AutoCaptions** ka ditaele tša lentšu le lengwe le le lengwe, dipeakanyo, motšhikinyego le medumo. **UN-NEST** le mekgwa ya go hlakanya (blend modes) di šoma go Premiere 26.5, **AUTO CUT** ke go tobetša gatee feela, gomme **Flex Studio (Beta)** e bula kliphi ya gago thwii go tšwa phaneleng.

*(Tsenya godimo ga phetolelo ya gago ya bjale gomme o thome Premiere Pro gape gatee.)*

♦️ **Mpsha: Dikepšene tše di šikinyegago go AutoCaptions**
* **Setaele sa lentšu**: efa lentšu lefe goba lefe mebala ya lona, fonto le phetho ya Flat, Shine goba Glow.
* **Dipeakanyo tša mothaladi**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside le Line.
* **Motšhikinyego wa lentšu ka lentšu** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake le tše dingwe) ka ponelopele, gape le medumo ya **Pop / Tick / Swoosh**. Ditaele tša mantšu le motšhikinyego di nyaka tšweletšo ya **Images**.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (leru, e diriša dikhrediti tša Flex AI) bjale ke enjene ye e šišinywago, e kgethilwe gatee go bohle; kgetha enjene ya Whisper go dira dikepšene mahala ntle le inthanete.
* **Your script** (mokgwa wa Captions): dikepšene di tšea mantšu a sengwalwa sa gago mo o boletšego mantšu ao.
* Ge go se selo se se kgethilwego (karata ya Source e se na selo), e go fa **thaimlaene ka moka**; dikepšene di bolokwa kgauswi le protšeke ya gago.

♦️ **Mpsha: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** e latiša kliphi ka gare ga tirišo; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** e romela tracking morago. Ga e so tsenywe? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** e a e laolla, ke moka e botšiša **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Go fetotšwe**
* **AUTO CUT** e sekaseka kliphi ye e kgethilwego gomme e ripa ka go tobetša gatee. **Retakes** e swara methalo yeo e thomilwego gape.
* **Audio Studio** bjale e na le di-sub-tab tše tshela. **Library** bjale e dula go Nest Saver.

♦️ **Go lokišitšwe**
* **UN-NEST** go Premiere 26.5 (e be e gana nest ye nngwe le ye nngwe), le mekgwa ya go hlakanya bjalo ka Screen yeo e bego e boela go Normal (Premiere ka Seisemane).
* Leswao le lehubedu la **AUTOSAVE 0:00**, ponelopele ye ntsho ya Caption Stack, le dieffekte tša theme tšeo di bego di le sieo go di-PC tše dintši tša Windows.

♦️ **Lefelo la boikgethelo go šireletša laesense**
* E botšišwa gatee feela, ke boikgethelo: ka **No thanks** tšohle di tšwela pele di šoma. E fetoše go **Flex Settings > Privacy**. E bolokwa dikgwedi tše 12, ga e rekišwe le ka mohla, ebile ga e abelanwe le ka mohla ntle le ge molao o nyaka seo.
